claim: Richer separation of source-time, observation-time, currentness, prediction and supersession may change how professional-services businesses manage client records, forecasts and continuity.

tests.result: Current GitHub source explicitly distinguishes source-time, observation-time, currentness, prediction and supersession.

falsifiers: No measurable workflow or economic advantage emerges from time-relative provenance/currentness.
Business models remain unchanged in representative test domains.
counterarguments: Better temporal provenance may increase complexity without sufficient user benefit.
Regulation, contracts and installed-base friction may dominate product design.
next_gate: Research at least three concrete workflows and measure before/after continuity or decision quality.
